factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment report shows real estate development revenue of EUR 31.6 million for 6M 2026 vs EUR 47.8 million for 6M 2025 (33.9% decrease) and operating profit of EUR 7.0 million vs EUR 11.9 million (40.8% decrease).

factual_claims.claim: Apartment sales declined to 120 from 222, and revenue from apartment sales fell to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 44.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Real estate development section states 120 apartments sold in 6M 2026 vs 222 in 6M 2025, with apartment sales revenue of EUR 27.6 million vs EUR 44.9 million.

factual_claims.claim: However, second-quarter development revenue and operating profit increased modestly year on year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Q2 data shows real estate development revenue of EUR 22.6 million for Q2 2026 vs EUR 21.6 million for Q2 2025, and operating profit of EUR 5.2 million vs EUR 4.9 million.

factual_claims.claim: The main positive development was the secured order book, which reached a record EUR 835.7 million at 30 June 2026, up approximately 88% from EUR 443.8 million a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report and overview state secured order book of EUR 835.7 million as of 30 June 2026 vs EUR 443.8 million as of 30 June 2025 (88% increase).

factual_claims.claim: New contracts signed during the first half totaled EUR 486.4 million, more than double the prior-year amount.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Secured order book section states EUR 486.4 million in new contracts signed in 6M 2026 vs EUR 223.1 million in 6M 2025 (more than double).

factual_claims.claim: Growth was driven largely by public-sector, Rail Baltica, defence-related and energy-infrastructure projects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report and outlook section identify public-sector, Rail Baltica, defence-related, and energy-infrastructure projects as key drivers of order book growth.

factual_claims.claim: The Rūdninkai defence force campus entered full-scale construction after the reporting date; its two phases have a combined construction cost exceeding EUR 370 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report states Rūdninkai defence force campus construction commenced in full scale after the reporting date, with total construction cost of the two phases exceeding EUR 370 million.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents rose to EUR 39.6 million from EUR 25.9 million, but operating cash flow was negative at EUR 31.6 million, primarily because of increased inventories and construction-contract balances.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows cash and cash equivalents of EUR 39.6 million as of 30 June 2026 vs EUR 25.9 million as of 30 June 2025, with operating cash flow of -EUR 31.6 million. Notes attribute this to increased inventories and changes in construction contract balances.

factual_claims.claim: Residential development investment increased to EUR 42.6 million from EUR 22.5 million, supported by additional borrowing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Real estate development section states investment in ongoing development projects was EUR 42.6 million in 6M 2026 vs EUR 22.5 million in 6M 2025. Cash flow from financing activities shows increased borrowing for development projects.

factual_claims.claim: Net debt rose to EUR 29.6 million, while the equity ratio remained strong at 57.4%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash position section states net debt of EUR 29.6 million as of 30 June 2026, with equity ratio of 57.4%.

factual_claims.claim: Overall, Merko entered the second half with weaker earnings and cash conversion but a significantly stronger project pipeline and increased construction activity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report and outlook conclude that despite weaker earnings and cash flow conversion, the company benefits from a stronger secured order book and increased construction activity.
